title: Build a Routine
coreMove: Stillness lasts when your day gives values a fixed place, then stays loose enough to protect people, recovery, and work when pressure rises.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose first hour gets taken by messages
exampleSpecs.stakes: the day begins by serving interruption instead of care
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A short message exchange lets Benjamin Franklin's evening review reshape the first calendar block.

exampleSpecs.audience: people whose morning is interrupted before the day begins
exampleSpecs.stakes: one interruption could turn the whole morning into reaction
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: An interrupted morning is rebuilt around one useful block.

exampleSpecs.audience: care workers and teachers preparing to be present
exampleSpecs.stakes: warmth could be left to mood instead of being supported
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small desk ritual shows how Benjamin Franklin's discipline supported care.

exampleSpecs.audience: workers who confuse intentions with scheduled practice
exampleSpecs.stakes: a missed review could be blamed on character instead of design
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A calendar export forces a choice between value language and protected time.

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders teaching routine without making it performative
exampleSpecs.stakes: discipline could become image management instead of support
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A wellness slide becomes a question about whom the routine protects.

exampleSpecs.audience: team leads building a humane work rhythm
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team could confuse stricter scheduling with better work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small studio chooses one shared rhythm instead of a memo artifact.
